documents.name: July 7 Minutes
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the July 7, 2025 Sykesville Planning Commission regular meeting.
documents.description: Minutes of the July 7, 2025 regular Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Singleton presided; Commissioner Smith absent. Two business items decided: (1) updated Warfield concept plan DENIED unanimously -- plan fails PEC land use percentages; (2) 2024 Water Resource Element draft APPROVED unanimously for MDE 60-day review. June 2, 2025 minutes approved. Meeting adjourned at 8:10 PM.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Carroll County updates for the August 4, 2025 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: Carroll County Bureau of Comprehensive Planning update for August 4, 2025. New planning liaison: Carlisle Fillat (Planning Technician). Water and sewer fall 2025 amendment requests due August 1. Master plan work groups (Housing, Economy, Agriculture) meeting through summer; staff attending farmers markets. Zoning text amendments on Adequate Public Facilities and solar development under review at August meetings; Employment Campus District recommendation forwarded to Board of County Commissioners.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.original_filename: Staff Report - Lib's Grill Site Plan and Plat
documents.synopsis: Staff report recommending approval of site plan and amended plat for Lib's Grill at the Station, 7618 Main St.
documents.description: Staff report for two related items at 7618 Main St (Parcel 479, Lots 1A and 2A, B-L zone, file S-24-0033): (1) site plan for Lib's Grill restaurant including a 1,602 sq ft kitchen addition and rear platform dining area improvements; (2) amended plat reconfiguring Lots 1A and 2A so the kitchen addition remains within Lot 1A. Staff recommends approval of both items with a waiver of the 43-space parking requirement due to proximity to public parking. Most Carroll County, HDC, and Maryland Historic Trust approvals already received.

documents.name: Site Plan
documents.original_filename: Site Plan - Lib's Grill at the Station (SF-25-0047)
documents.synopsis: Site plan drawing for Lib's Grill at the Station, 7618 Main St.
documents.description: Site plan (SF-25-0047) for Lib's Grill at the Station at 7618 Main St. Shows the original train station building, existing rear patio/platform, and the proposed 1,602 sq ft kitchen addition on the western side of the structure.

documents.name: Amended Plat
documents.synopsis: Amended record plat for Sykesville Train Station, Parcel 479 Lots 1A and 2A.
documents.description: Amended record plat (April 15, 2025) prepared by Sill Engineering Group for Parcel 479, Lots 1A (20,983.81 SF / 0.4817 ac) and 2A (14,199.61 SF / 0.3260 ac), Tax Map 21, Grid 10, Carroll County, Maryland. Reconfigures the original Lots 1 and 2 of the Sykesville Train Station (Plat Book 29, Page 138) to allow the proposed kitchen addition to remain within Lot 1A. Owner: Town of Sykesville.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.synopsis: August 4, 2025 Sykesville Planning Commission regular meeting agenda.
documents.description: Agenda for the August 4, 2025 Sykesville Planning Commission regular meeting at 7547 Main Street, Town House. Items: approval of July 7, 2025 minutes; Carroll County updates; site plan for Lib's Grill at the Station (7618 Main St) with parking waiver; amended plat for Parcel 479 Lots 1A and 2A; and town updates.
